messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game themed “2D Diablo loot in a Vampire Survivors run.”

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game with hand-drawn canvas visuals, automatically attacking enemies, loot drops and equipment, level-up boons, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`, including title screen, survivor gameplay loop, inventory/equipment, boss waves, level-up choices, and run summary.
- Extracted the inline script and passed `node --check`.

### Active
- Browser verification and screenshot capture have not been done.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the running game at `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`.
2. Start a run, inspect browser console and gameplay, and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix any issues discovered and summarize assumptions when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/game.js`: extracted script used for `node --check`; regenerate it if the inline script changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked.
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- User’s duplicated request was the same: “2D Diablo loot in a Vampire Survivors run.”

**Controls:** Move with WASD or arrow keys, dash with Space, and collect nearby loot with E. Click items in your satchel to equip them. On touchscreens, drag to move and tap nearby loot.
